glosses.notes: Can mean a plan itself or the act of planning how work, space, time, or development should be arranged.

examples.sentence: 市里公布新区规划以后，原来想搬家的几户人又留下来看，因为学校、医院和路都会一起重新安排。
老师让我们先把三年的学习规划写下来，再看看哪些目标太满、哪些时间太紧，不然执行的时候一定会乱。
公司决定先规划好搬进新办公室后的座位和设备位置，这样大家正式进去那天就不会临时找来找去。

example_translations.translation: After the city announced the new district plan, several families that had wanted to move decided to stay and watch a little longer, because the schools, hospital, and roads would all be rearranged together.

The teacher told us to write out our three-year study plan first, then look at which goals were too packed and which time limits were too tight, otherwise things would definitely get messy when we tried to carry it out.
The company decided to plan the seating and equipment layout before moving into the new office, so that people would not have to search around at the last minute on the day everyone moved in.

glosses.notes: Used for returning something to the person or place it belongs to, especially books, money, tools, or other borrowed things.

examples.sentence: 图书馆发消息提醒大家尽快归还上个月借走的书，因为下周开始有很多学生要来找这些书。
他把朋友借给自己的书整理好以后一起归还给对方，还认真说了谢谢。
老师要求他先归还前几天拿走的书，再谈别的问题，不然大家没有办法继续开会。

example_translations.translation: The library sent out a message reminding everyone to return the books they had borrowed last month as soon as possible, because many students would start looking for them next week.
After tidying up the book his friend had lent him, he returned it to the other person and sincerely said thank you.
The teacher asked him to return the books he had taken away a few days earlier before discussing other matters, otherwise everyone would have no way to continue the meeting.

glosses.notes: Can mean a rule or customary practice, and it can also describe someone as orderly and well-behaved.

examples.sentence: 这家店地方不大，可是规矩很多，先排队，再说自己要什么，最后还要把碗自己放回去。
平时最爱闹的那个孩子一进医院就突然变得很规矩，连走路都轻了，怕影响别人休息。
第一次去那边做客的人如果不懂当地规矩，往往会把主人已经准备好的顺序全打乱，自己还不知道。

example_translations.translation: This shop is not big, but it has many rules: queue first, then say what you want, and in the end you still have to put your own bowl back yourself.
The child who is usually the noisiest suddenly became very well-behaved as soon as he entered the hospital, and even walked more softly because he was afraid of disturbing other people resting there.
If someone visiting there for the first time does not understand the local customs, they will often throw off the whole order the host has already prepared without even realizing it.

glosses.notes: Usually means a track, rail, or fixed path. It can also mean an orbital path or a stable track of development.

examples.sentence: 工人沿着旧轨道一直往前看了很久，才发现前面那一段因为下了很多天雨已经往下沉，所以车只能慢慢开。
老师说月亮一直按自己的轨道走，所以我们每个月都能在天上慢慢看见它的变化。
新负责人接手以后，原先拖了很久的合作总算慢慢回到稳定轨道上，大家开会时也不再互相推责任。

example_translations.translation: The worker looked forward along the old track for a long time before discovering that the section ahead had already sunk downward because it had rained for many days, so the vehicle could only move slowly.
The teacher said the moon keeps moving along its own orbit, so every month we can gradually see its changes in the sky.

After the new person took charge, the cooperation that had been dragging on for a long time finally began to return to a stable track, and people stopped pushing responsibility onto one another during meetings.

glosses.notes: Means to kneel down, often in prayer, apology, pleading, or because the body is too tired to stay standing.

examples.sentence: 老人刚进门就慢慢跪下来，把带来的花和水果放好，然后安静地闭上眼睛想了很久。
孩子发现自己把爷爷最喜欢的杯子打碎了，吓得差点当场跪下认错，声音都开始变了。
训练结束以后，大家累得一坐下就不想动，只有他还跪在地上继续找刚才掉进草里的钥匙。

example_translations.translation: The old man slowly knelt down as soon as he came in, set out the flowers and fruit he had brought, and then quietly closed his eyes and thought for a long time.
When the child realized he had broken his grandfather's favorite cup, he was so frightened that he nearly dropped to his knees on the spot to admit his fault, and even his voice began to change.

After training ended, everyone was so tired that they did not want to move once they sat down, but he was still kneeling on the ground looking for the key that had fallen into the grass a moment earlier.

glosses.notes: Describes something that is materially valuable or precious enough that people handle it with extra care.

examples.sentence: 搬家的时候，母亲先把几样贵重东西和证件单独放在包里，怕人一多就一下找不到。
工作人员把最贵重的几件东西先放到里面的房间里，还另外加了一层保护，谁都不能随便碰。
她提醒我出门不要带太多贵重东西，因为人又多、地方又暗，掉了就不好找了。

example_translations.translation: When they were moving, Mother first put several valuable things and important documents separately into her bag, afraid that once too many people were around, they would suddenly be hard to find.
The staff first put the most precious items into an inner room and added another layer of protection, so no one could touch them casually.
She reminded me not to carry too many valuables when going out, because there would be lots of people and the place would be dark, and if something dropped it would be hard to find.

glosses.notes: Refers to a stick, rod, club, or other long hard object held in the hand or used as a tool.

examples.sentence: 院子后面那只狗看见陌生人就爱叫，所以门边一直放着一根长棍，平时主要用来把它挡回去。
爷爷把衣服从高处拿下来时，总爱顺手拿一根棍，因为站在上面还是会摇。
大家看见门边那根铁棍上还有新的颜色，这才觉得门很可能是从外面被人打开的。

example_translations.translation: The dog behind the yard always barks when it sees strangers, so a long stick is always kept by the door, mainly to block it back.
When Grandfather took clothes down from a high place, he always liked to grab a stick on the way, because he still swayed while standing up there.
When people saw fresh color marks on the iron rod by the door, they started to think the door had probably been opened from outside.

glosses.notes: Used for things a country treasures deeply, such as especially important animals, artworks, or historical objects.

examples.sentence: 孩子第一次在电视上看到那只刚出生的大熊猫时，才真正明白为什么大家总把它叫作国宝。
工作人员清理那件国宝文物的时候，旁边站着的人连呼吸都不敢太重，怕一点灰落上去都麻烦。
很多游客排了两个小时的队，就是想近距离看看这件国宝，结果进去以后反而先安静下来，不敢大声说话。

example_translations.translation: When the child first saw that newborn giant panda on television, he finally understood why people always call it a national treasure.

While the staff were cleaning that national-treasure cultural object, the people standing nearby hardly dared to breathe too heavily, afraid that even a little dust falling onto it would cause trouble.
Many tourists stood in line for two hours just to see this national treasure up close, yet once they got inside they grew quiet first and did not dare speak loudly.

glosses.notes: Describes products manufactured in the home country rather than imported from abroad.

examples.sentence: 父亲买东西时原来只看国外牌子，后来试了几款国产产品，才发现声音和电池都已经很够用了。
这家店最近把国产牛奶和水果放在最前面，希望大家先看到自己国家做出来的东西。
导演坚持主要设备尽量用国产品牌，一方面方便维修，另一方面也想让年轻观众看到本地技术的进步。

example_translations.translation: When Father was buying things, he originally looked only at foreign brands, but after trying several domestically made products, he realized that the sound and battery were already more than good enough.
This shop recently put domestic milk and fruit right at the front, hoping people would first notice things made in their own country.

The director insisted on using domestic brands for the main equipment whenever possible, partly because repairs would be easier and partly because he wanted young viewers to see the progress of local technology.

glosses.notes: The official patriotic song of a country, especially sung or played at ceremonies, schools, sports events, and public occasions.

examples.sentence: 大家一起唱国歌的时候，刚才还在说话的人都站直了，连最小的孩子也没有乱跑。
她第一次出国，听见房间里放起自己国家的国歌时，突然想起家里电视前常坐着的爷爷。
老师解释为什么会有这首国歌以后，学生再唱的时候明显更认真，因为每一句后面都有自己的意思。

example_translations.translation: When everyone sang the national anthem together, even the people who had just been talking stood up straight, and even the youngest children stopped running around.
When she went abroad for the first time and heard her country's national anthem start playing in the room, she suddenly thought of the grandfather who often sat in front of the television at home.
After the teacher explained why this national anthem existed, the students were noticeably more serious when they sang it again, because every line carried its own meaning.

glosses.notes: The official flag of a country, often seen at schools, ceremonies, public squares, and government buildings.

examples.sentence: 天刚亮的时候，广场边已经站满了等着看国旗升起的人，很多人明明困得很，还是一直没有离开。
台风过后，学校先把操场边被吹落的国旗重新挂好，又检查了一遍周围的电线，确认安全才让学生靠近。
孩子画画的时候把国旗上星星的位置画错了，父亲没有急着批评，只是拿出书来慢慢和他一起改。

example_translations.translation: At daybreak, the edge of the square was already full of people waiting to watch the national flag rise; many of them were clearly very sleepy, but they still did not leave.

After the typhoon passed, the school first rehung the national flag that had been blown down by the athletic field, then checked the surrounding power lines again and only let students come near after confirming it was safe.
While drawing, the child put the stars on the national flag in the wrong places. His father did not hurry to scold him, but instead took out a book and slowly corrected it with him.

glosses.notes: Refers to the real conditions of a country, such as its population, economy, society, habits, and stage of development.

examples.sentence: 负责人去外地考察回来以后一直强调，别人的办法不能原样搬来，因为两边人口、交通和国情都差得很远。
那位记者在节目里解释当地国情时，没有只说数字，还把普通人怎么上学、看病和找工作都讲清楚了。
老师让我们讨论一项新政策时先看本国国情，不要一听见国外有类似做法，就以为直接照搬一定有效。

example_translations.translation: After returning from an inspection trip elsewhere, the person in charge kept stressing that other people's methods could not simply be copied exactly, because the population, transport, and national conditions of the two places were very different.

When that reporter explained the local national conditions on the program, she did not just talk about numbers. She also clearly described how ordinary people there go to school, see a doctor, and look for work.

When the teacher asked us to discuss a new policy, she told us to look at our own country's national conditions first, not hear that another country had a similar method and assume that copying it directly would definitely work.

glosses.notes: A male monarch or ruler of a kingdom. It often appears in history, stories, legends, and political discussion.

examples.sentence: 孩子睡前听到国王偷偷换上普通衣服走进城里看大家过得怎么样的那一段时，马上坐起来追问后面发生了什么。
电影里的老国王虽然年纪大了，可是开会时一句话都不肯随便说，因为每个决定都会影响很多人。
老师介绍那座旧房子的时候提到，几百年前有位国王就是在这里见外国人，并当场决定不打仗了。

example_translations.translation: At bedtime, when the child heard the part about the king secretly changing into ordinary clothes and walking into the city to see how people were living, he immediately sat up and asked what happened next.
Although the old king in the film was already elderly, he still refused to speak carelessly during meetings, because every decision would affect many people.
While introducing that old house, the teacher mentioned that hundreds of years ago a king met foreigners there and decided on the spot that they would stop fighting.

glosses.notes: Used for moving gradually from one stage, system, method, or condition to another instead of changing all at once.

examples.sentence: 新旧系统要一起用三个月，不是因为大家犹豫，而是想让资料、人员和工作习惯都有一个安全的过渡。
孩子从小学过渡到初中的那半年里，母亲每天都陪他一起整理作业和时间表，怕他一下跟不上。
医生说这种药不能突然停，要慢慢过渡到新的方案，不然身体可能一时适应不过来，反而更难受。

example_translations.translation: The old and new systems need to be used together for three months, not because people are hesitant, but because they want the data, staff, and work habits all to have a safe transition.

During the half year when the child was transitioning from primary school to middle school, his mother helped him organize his homework and schedule every day because she was afraid he would not be able to keep up all at once.
The doctor said this medicine could not be stopped all at once. It had to transition gradually to a new plan, otherwise the body might not adapt in time and things could feel even worse.

glosses.notes: Means after something has happened or passed, often after a meeting, argument, storm, event, or period of time.

examples.sentence: 会议过后，几个人没有马上离开，而是站在楼下把刚才没来得及说完的问题又重新理了一遍。
风雨过后，河边的路上全是叶子和小树，大家从天一亮就开始一点一点把它们拿开。
争论过后，他回到家里才发现自己最在意的其实不是输赢，而是朋友那句一直没有解释清楚的话。

example_translations.translation: After the meeting, several people did not leave right away. Instead, they stood downstairs and sorted through the questions they had not had time to finish talking about.
After the storm, the road by the river was covered with leaves and small broken branches, and from daybreak everyone started moving them away little by little.
After the argument, he got home and only then realized that what bothered him most was not who had won or lost, but the sentence his friend had never explained clearly.

glosses.notes: Describes something as no longer suited to the present time, or says that it has gone out of fashion.

examples.sentence: 这家店的装修多年没变，连墙上的海报都已经过时了，可是老板觉得只要味道没变，老客人就还会来。
老师提醒我们，十年前那套管理办法放到今天已经有点过时，不能再拿来处理现在这么复杂的情况。
她把几件明显过时的衣服拿出来送人，却把母亲年轻时留下的一件小心放好，因为那是回忆。

example_translations.translation: The decor of this shop has not changed for many years, and even the posters on the wall are already outdated, but the owner thinks that as long as the taste has not changed, the old customers will still come.
The teacher reminded us that the management method from ten years ago is already somewhat outdated today and can no longer be used to handle situations as complicated as the current ones.
She took several clearly outdated clothes out and gave them away, but carefully put aside one that her mother had left from her younger days because it held memories.

glosses.notes: Used for people, places, or reactions both within the country and outside it.

examples.sentence: 消息一公布，海内外很多人都主动写信回来，不但问学校现在怎么样，还表示愿意帮年轻学生找工作。
那场演出原本只想在本地办几天，没想到海内外观众都在网上讨论，最后主办方只好临时加场。
这家小店卖的不是最贵的茶，却因为老板几十年都守着同一道工序，在海内外慢慢积累了不少懂行的客人。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the news was announced, many people at home and abroad took the initiative to write back, not only asking how the school was doing now but also saying they were willing to help young students find work.

That performance had originally only planned to stay in the local area for a few days, but unexpectedly audiences at home and abroad all started discussing it online, so in the end the organizers had to add extra shows at the last minute.
This small shop does not sell the most expensive tea, yet because the owner has kept to the same process for decades, it has gradually built up many knowledgeable customers at home and abroad.

glosses.notes: The line of land next to the sea, especially when talking about scenery, weather, fishing, transport, or coastal life.

examples.sentence: 清晨的海岸还没有多少游客，只有几个捡垃圾的人沿着石头慢慢往前走，海风一阵一阵吹得脸发凉。
台风快到的时候，海岸上听见广播的人都立刻往回走，因为再晚一点船就很难回来了。
我们从高处看那段海岸时，才发现远处那个塔其实比照片里小得多，只是站的位置让它看起来特别清楚。

example_translations.translation: There were still not many tourists on the coast in the early morning. Only a few people picking up trash were slowly walking forward along the rocks, while the sea wind blew in waves and made their faces feel cold.
When the typhoon was about to arrive, the people on the coast who heard the broadcast all turned back at once, because if they were any later, the boats would have a hard time getting back.
When we looked at that stretch of coast from high up, we realized that the tower in the distance was much smaller than it looked in photos; its position simply made it look especially clear.

glosses.notes: Used for how high a place is above sea level, especially with mountains, roads, towns, or scientific measurement.

examples.sentence: 车往山上开的时候，导游一再提醒大家这里海拔高、空气薄，刚下车不要跑太快，先慢慢走一会儿。
研究人员把仪器搬到不同海拔的位置连续测了几天，想看看温度、风和植物变化到底有什么关系。
孩子第一次到这么高海拔的地方，晚上连睡觉都觉得呼吸有点急，第二天早上反而不敢像平时那样乱跑。

example_translations.translation: As the car drove up the mountain, the guide kept reminding everyone that the altitude here was high and the air was thin, so after getting out they should not run too fast and should walk slowly for a while first.
The researchers moved their instruments to places at different altitudes and measured continuously for several days, wanting to see what relationship temperature, wind, and plant changes really had.

It was the child's first time in such a high-altitude place, and at night he even felt a little short of breath while sleeping, so the next morning he did not dare run around the way he normally would.

glosses.notes: Refers to the visible surface of the sea, especially when describing light, waves, weather, ships, or search activity.

examples.sentence: 太阳刚出来的时候，海面上那片光一直跟着船往前走，连最爱说话的人都安静地看了很久。
风忽然变大以后，原本很平的海面一下动得很厉害，船上的人马上提醒大家坐好。
大家在海面看见一件衣服时，先不敢确定是不是那个人留下的东西，于是继续往四周找。

example_translations.translation: When the sun had just come up, that patch of light on the sea surface kept moving forward with the ship, and even the most talkative people watched quietly for a long time.
After the wind suddenly grew stronger, the sea surface, which had originally been calm, started moving violently, and the people on the boat immediately reminded everyone to sit properly.
When people spotted a piece of clothing on the sea surface, they did not dare confirm at once whether it had been left by that person, so they kept searching around it.

glosses.notes: Refers to a section of sea or maritime area, especially in fishing, research, weather, or management contexts.

examples.sentence: 船进入那片海域以前，带头的人先把天气和最近的通知都又看了一遍，怕大家忙起来会忘。
消息里说那片海域这几天风太大，小船最好不要靠近，所以原来想出海拍照的人都把时间往后改了。
他们每个月都要看海域里的水有多热、颜色怎么变、鱼有多少，这些看起来很平常的记录其实特别重要。

example_translations.translation: Before the boat entered those waters, the person leading the group went over the weather and the latest notices again, afraid that once everyone got busy they might forget.

The message said that the wind in that sea area had been too strong these past few days and that small boats had better stay away, so the people who had planned to go out to sea and take pictures all moved their time back.
Every month they check how warm the water is in those waters, how its color changes, and how many fish there are. Those records may look ordinary, but they are actually very important.

glosses.notes: Can mean harm or damage as a noun, and can also mean to injure, damage, or put someone in danger as a verb.

examples.sentence: 他知道这种小病如果一直不看，时间长了可能害自己，所以还是马上去医院了。
这种药上面写得很清楚，量太多不但没有好处，反而可能带来不小的害，所以一定要照着用。
为了省一点时间就让孩子坐没有保护的后座，其实是在害他，真出了事以后再后悔就太晚了。

example_translations.translation: He knew that if this minor illness kept going unchecked for a long time, it could end up harming him, so he still went to the hospital right away.
It is written very clearly on this medicine: taking too much not only brings no benefit, it may actually do considerable harm, so it really has to be used as directed.
Letting a child sit in the back seat without protection just to save a little time is actually putting the child in danger. If something really happens, regretting it afterward will be too late.

glosses.notes: A very cold winter, often used for hard weather itself or for a difficult period likened to winter.

examples.sentence: 那几年生意最难的时候正赶上寒冬，街上天一黑就没什么人，可是这家小店还是靠老顾客慢慢撑了下来。
寒冬一到，山里的老人最怕的不是下雪，而是天太冷以后路不好走，出去买药就更难了，所以村里总会早点准备。
新闻照片里，寒冬清晨的站台上每个人都把围巾拉到脸边，只剩眼睛还在看远处的车灯有没有出现。

example_translations.translation: Those years when business was hardest happened to coincide with a harsh winter period. As soon as it got dark, there was almost no one on the street, yet the little shop still managed to hold on slowly with the support of old customers.

As soon as the harsh winter arrived, what the old people in the mountains feared most was not the snow, but that once the weather turned too cold the roads would be hard to walk, making it even harder to go buy medicine, so the village always prepared early.

In the news photo, on the station platform in the cold winter dawn, everyone had pulled their scarves up to their faces, leaving only their eyes watching to see whether the distant headlights had appeared yet.

glosses.notes: The meaning or significance of a word, sentence, symbol, action, or expression, including what it suggests beneath the surface.

examples.sentence: 老师没有直接说答案，而是让我们先比较前后两段的语气，这样词语真正的含义就自己慢慢显出来了。
同一句话放在不同场合里，含义可能完全不一样，所以她回消息之前总要先想清楚对方当时的表情和语气。
孩子听见大人说那句老话时只记住了字面意思，过了很多年才真正明白里面更深的含义和提醒。

example_translations.translation: The teacher did not give the answer directly. Instead, she told us to compare the tone of the two passages before and after it first, and in that way the word's true meaning slowly showed itself.

The same sentence can carry a completely different meaning in different situations, so before replying to a message she always thinks carefully about the other person's expression and tone at the time.
When the child heard the adults say that old phrase, he only remembered its literal sense. It was only many years later that he truly understood its deeper meaning and warning.

glosses.notes: Describes something as rare or unusual enough that people do not often see it in normal life.

examples.sentence: 医生说这种情况虽然罕见，可是一旦出现就不能拖，所以检查结果刚出来，大家就立刻开始联系专家。
这次公开拿出来的那张纸非常罕见，很多人专门从外地赶来，就是想亲眼看看上面的字和改动。
这个时候山顶还能看见这么大的云本来就很少，更罕见的是风那么小，连云都像没有动。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that although this situation is rare, once it appears it cannot be delayed, so as soon as the test results came out, everyone immediately began contacting specialists.

The sheet of paper brought out for public display this time is extremely rare. Many people came specially from other places because they wanted to see the writing and revisions on it with their own eyes.
At this time, it is already uncommon to still see clouds this large on the mountaintop, and even rarer is that the wind is so slight that even the clouds seem not to move.
